profile.headline: BI Specialist/SRE/DevOps
profile.summary: Experienced SRE/DevOps Engineer. Initially as a DataWarehouse/BI developer across all stages of the application development cycle including analysis, design, development, implementation and support on a variety industries including but not limited to Telecom, Financial, Health, Transportation and Services I have evolved to a Cloud Engineer to solve a wide variety of complex problems for tunning processes and deploying applications on a multi-cultural and demanding environments using agile methodologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer/SRE/DevOps
positions.description:
•	Transformation and support of proprietary legacy products to Google GCP by working with development team to migrate a wide variety of applications using multiple solution services like Cloud DataProc (Hadoop), Cloud Dataflow (Apache Beam), GKE (Kubernetes), Cloud Datastore (noSQL DB) and Cloud Pub/Sub.

•	Implementation of automation efforts to maintain an effective Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery CI/CD agile cycle tools using Jenkins, GitHub, NexusIQ, SonarQube and Fortify.

•	Development, maintenance and support Equifax proprietary legacy Capital Market products: Credit Risk Insight (CRI), Undisclosed Debt Monitoring and Data Accountability batch processes to consolidate mortgage loan data and extract borrower’s credit file information to build a loan level specific predictor of portfolio of consumer’s health report.

positions.title: BI Systems Specialist
positions.description:
•	Design, Development and Implementation of SQL Generator as unique framework in PLSQL to dynamically translate user specific requests into fine tune SQL statements to extract data and be consumed by GP Operational Data Store.
•	Design, Development and Implementation of Reporting Extract Layout using Oracle PLSQL to dynamically generate and automate standard Layout file output.
•	Design, Development and Implementation of various data report metrics load for Jaspersoft.
•	Design, Development and Implementation of monthly and on demand delta process to track any data change for the Marketing DB.
•	Revamp Auto Matching process in T-SQL to remove timeout constraints and record and table locking issues.
•	Point of contact and follow Scrum call meetings to track project releases.

Software : Oracle PLSQL, SQL Developer, PGSQL, GreenPlum, Unix Shell Scripting, Jaspersoft Server/Report, Agile-Scrum

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description:
•	Migration, implementation, translation and integration of the Metranet operational data store to the ETL Jobs using PLSQL.
•	Design, development, maintenance and support the Revenue and Tax Datamart schemas (Facts and Dimensions).
•	Support monthly billing reconciliation processes for NA, EMEA and APAC business units and provide performance tuning to several ad hoc reporting needs.
•	Implementation of the new Universal Service Fee taxation ETL processes and Datamart for government regulation.
•	Design and Implementation of the Legal Tax audit Datamart for Legal department. 

Tools/Methodologies:  Oracle DB 11g, Microsoft Office, Visio, Project, Toad, Unix-Linux, Metratech, APEX
